title: Blue-Based Receptions
description: Navy and dusty-blue florals run the length of raw wood farm tables, with floating candles, gold-rimmed glassware, and a matching dessert and favor spread. The same palette scales up to the room — a draped ballroom in white and blue, a head table run with eucalyptus and pillar candles, and guest tables finished with navy overlays and satin chair sashes.
